response.overview: Super Bowl LIV, played on February 2, 2020, at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens, Florida, saw the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the San Francisco 49ers 31-20 to win their first Super Bowl title in 50 years. The victory marked the culmination of a thrilling postseason run and confirmed the Chiefs as the new kings of the NFL after decades of close calls and near-misses.
response.tagline: Kansas City Chiefs vs. San Francisco 49ers
response.title: Super Bowl LIV
